goal: Play the game as a real player would: Each player gets a bright plot with a dropper that spawns a 1-cash cube every 2 seconds onto a conveyor. The conveyor carries cubes to a collector at the end, and the server adds each cube's value to the player's Cash leaderstat and destroys the cube. Two buy pads sit off to the side of the walking area: a second dropper for 25 cash and a faster conveyor for 5
summary: The playtester mostly tested the shop and rebirth UI, but the economy loop ran throughout. Cash rose steadily (0 → 11 → 33 → 84 → 108) and the probe counted 124 cubes dropped and 123 collected. Dropper and conveyor purchases registered (dropper_bought 2, conveyor_bought 1, upgrades_bought 4), with no server errors. The one real defect is that displayed prices disagree with each other and with the brief.

bugs.title: Dropper 2 / Speed 1 prices inconsistent between HUD hint, shop, pads and brief
bugs.evidence: Step 2: HUD says 'Next: Dropper 25 (have 11)', but the shop card and pad show 'Dropper 2 - $10' and the purchase succeeded with 11 cash. Steps 6-9: the hint says 'Next: Fast Belt 50' while the pad reads 'Speed 1 - $60'. The brief says 25 for the second dropper. Players get conflicting costs and the tutorial hint is wrong.

bugs.title: Shop Buy gives no feedback when cash is insufficient
